description.description: Represents the description of a device.

comment.description: A comment expressed in the MaC from the installer.

orderNumber.description: order number string of this device (derived from the product)

manufacturer.description: the producer/manufacturer of the device, string

lastModified.description: last device modification, date/ time in ISO 8601/ RFC 3339 format, <https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339#section-5.6>

lastDownloaded.description: last device download, date/ time in ISO 8601/ RFC 3339 format, <https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339#section-5.6>

currentDateTime.description: The current system time of the device, reflecting the time which the underlying system is using, date/ time in ISO 8601/ RFC 3339 format, <https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339#section-5.6>

serialNumber.description: By KNX specified KNX Serial Number of the device, set during manufacturing process

individualAddress.description: device address as part of the installation, set in MaC during configuration
